build_inputs.angles:
Same power as the V8 it replaced, and 125 lb-ft more torque. The old RS5
had a 4.2 naturally aspirated V8 making about 450 hp but only ~317 lb-ft.
The 2.9 twin-turbo V6 makes 444 hp and 443 lb-ft — and all of it from 1,900 rpm.
Audi quotes 0-60 in 3.9 seconds. Testers have got 3.3 out of it. The
company undersells its own car.
The complaint that sticks is the noise. Reviewers found the V6 flat and
characterless next to the V8 — faster, duller.
The Sportback body didn't exist before. The previous RS5 was coupe and
convertible only; five doors with the same performance is new.
174 mph top speed.

title: Audi RS5 Sportback: Same V8 Power, More Torque 🔥

history.fact: The Audi RS5 Sportback made its global debut at the 2018 New York International Auto Show, marking the first time Audi introduced a five-door high-performance coupe in the RS lineup.

scenes.narration: Would you expect a sleek five-door to pack 444 horsepower and the power of a V8 with more torque?

scenes.headline: 0-60 in 3.9 sec
scenes.narration: Audi quotes a 0-60 time of 3.9 seconds, yet testers have achieved 3.3, proving the numbers can be deceiving.
Under the hood, the RS badge sits proudly above the 2.9-liter twin-turbo V6, delivering 443 lb-ft of torque and maintaining peak output after replacing the V8.

scenes.headline: Distinctive Cabin
scenes.narration: Inside, carbon fiber accents on the dashboard and console reduce weight, adding to the RS experience.
The RS5 Sportback stands out with distinctive red calipers encased in matte black wheels, revealing its performance lineage.

scenes.headline: Sportback Body
scenes.narration: This generation introduced the Sportback body, adding practicality without sacrificing performance.
Leather sport seats feature honeycomb stitching and RS logos, focusing on both style and hold during spirited drives.
Originally around $75,000, the RS5 Sportback showcases Audi’s commitment to blending practical performance with style.
